title: Sensorik announces +2.6 % on Pressure sensor 0-16 bar
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Sensorik Ammertal GmbH. Sensorik announces +2.6 % on Pressure sensor 0-16 bar. Need: 14740 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 30 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.
